name: HANKOOKILBO MCP
description:
한국일보(https://www.hankookilbo.com)의 주요 뉴스, 섹션별 추천 기사, AI 기반 기사 검색, 오늘의 운세 등 공개 메타데이터를 검색 및 조회하는 MCP 서버입니다.

제목, 발행일자, 분야, 기자 정보, 원문 링크 및 본문 일부를 제공합니다.

주요 기능 및 도구:
- 오늘의 주요 뉴스 / 지금 볼만한 뉴스 / 많이 본 뉴스 / 최신 기사 목록 조회
- 분야(섹션) 목록 및 섹션별 추천 기사 조회
- 자연어 질의 기반 AI 관련 기사 검색
- 오늘의 운세 및 MBTI 운세 메타데이터 조회

_published_faq.name: How do I add HANKOOKILBO MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HANKOOKILBO MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hankookilbo.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is HANKOOKILBO MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, HANKOOKILBO MCP scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HANKOOKILBO MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HANKOOKILBO MCP provides these MCP tools: get_daily_horoscope, get_mbti_horoscope, list_latest_news, list_most_read_news, list_popular_news, list_recommended_articles, list_sections, list_timely_news, list_top_headlines, and search_news.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HANKOOKILBO MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HANKOOKILBO MCP in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, Ticketbox.vn, drawnames, and Coffeetable.

_published_faq.name: Does HANKOOKILBO MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: HANKOOKILBO MCP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
HANKOOKILBO MCP is developed by Hankookilbo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
